title: Associative holism dimension-law no-go

claims.holism_balance: For any associative accessible-dimension composition q_AB=q_A q_B+h_AB, h_AB q_C+h_(AB),C=q_A h_BC+h_A,(BC).
claims.nonuniqueness_family: For every integer k>=0, F_k(a,b)=ab+k(a-1)(b-1) is positive-integer valued, commutative, associative, unital, monotone, and satisfies F_k(a,b)>=ab.
claims.consequence: Associativity + commutativity + a trivial unit + monotonicity + faithful product lower bound do not uniquely determine a PDT composition law, even at parameter-counting level.

prior_art_boundary: Local tomography K_AB=K_A K_B and failures such as real/bilocal quantum theories are established GPT/reconstruction prior art. The algebraic F_k counterfamily is used only as a PDT-specific no-go witness; historical novelty is not claimed.
remaining_open_target: A PDT-native physical principle must constrain the admissible holistic sector itself; ordinary monoidal consistency axioms at dimension-counting level are insufficient.
